# netbox_vlan_translation_rule (Resource)

Manages a NetBox VLAN translation rule (`/api/ipam/vlan-translation-rules/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_vlan_translation_rule" "example" {
  policy_id = netbox_vlan_translation_policy.example.id
  local_vid = 1
  remote_vid = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `local_vid` (Number) Numeric VLAN ID (1-4094).
- `policy_id` (Number) ID of the Vlan Translation Policy (`netbox_vlan_translation_policy`).
- `remote_vid` (Number) Numeric VLAN ID (1-4094).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
```
